verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own docs claim continuous monitoring with alerts, which covers the core idea of being notified about control failures, but only as a single marketing-level mention. The ClickUp and Jira integrations appear as ticketing connections under Change Management, which suggests evidence ingestion rather than pushing findings out as tickets. Its webhooks are inbound only, so neither counts as outbound alert delivery. Missing for 10: documented Slack alert delivery, documented email alerts for control failures or drift, ticket creation from failed controls, description of the remediation context included in alerts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
